title: Read Between the Lines
author: Bob Isaacs
problems: Row 2 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 5 "partners allemande right 1¼ To long waves robins facing in" can't start from where the dancers are: This allemande does not end facing across, in long waves.
Row 1 "slide left along set" can't start from where the dancers are: slide starts before a waiting couple finishes crossing.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
